sessionStart.powershell: $r = $env:COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r = $env:CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT }; if (-not $r) { $r = (Get-Location).Path }; $s = (Join-Path $r 'scripts\write-session-guidance.ps1'); if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $s -PathType Leaf) { & $s } else { [Console]::Out.Write('{}') }
sessionStart.bash: r="${COPILOT_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-$PWD}}}"; s="$r/scripts/write-session-guidance.sh"; if [ -f "$s" ]; then bash "$s"; else printf '{}'; fi
